page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left and right margins. Printed page 279 at the head. Below the text, the gathering signature S 4.

main_text.p: mo patris mei, inquit Salomon. Liceat enim mihi iisdem verbis uti de Bellarminia Pfal. 57.5. lingua gladio acuto; quibus nobilissimus ille rex sententiam de caede a Ioabo injuste facta tulit: b 1.Reg.2.33Et retorquebit Iehova sanguinem eius in caput eius, qui irruit in duos homines iustiores & meliores se, & occidit eos gladio, patre meo Davide ignorante: Sic re-versis cadibus eorum in caput Ioab, & in caput feminis eius in seculum; Davidi, id est, femini eius, & domui eius, ac folio eius erit pax usque in seculum à Iehova.
main_text.head: CAP. VIII.

p.i: Protestantes falsò à Bellarmino accusari, tanquam nullum Sanctis hominibus mortuis Angelisve honorem haberi velint. Tum Papistas illis honorem debitum detrahere.

main_text.p: BOnassus{c}, animal quoddam magnitudine tauri, cornua in se flexa & pugnae inutilia gerens, postquam percussus est a venatoribus, fimume Ariftot. hist.animal. lib.9.cap.45. saepe in fuga ad quatuor passus a se projicit, cujus contactus pilos infectantium canum adurit & absumit. Istius animalis similimus est Bellarminus: cornua sibi faciens, qualiad 1.Reg.22.11. Sedekias, speciosiora ad pompam quàm ad pugnam; & fimum calumniarum ita ejaculans in nostros eum

page.notes: The initial B is a woodcut letter joined to Onassus; the word is read as Onassus, with the first letters of the initial word uncertain. The superscript c after Onassus has no matching marginal note on this page. The reference after "b" reads 1.Reg.2.33 but the numerals are uncertain. The reference after "d" (1.Reg.22.11) is uncertain in its numerals. The stray mark in the left margin beside "num adurit" is not text and is left out. Long s is copied as plain s throughout.
